shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -30; git log --stat --oneline | head -20; node -v; npm -v

cat index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Theme 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i router

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/index.d.ts; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/TabList/TabList.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ 2>/dev/null | head -3

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/types.d.ts; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout; echo ----; grep -n "body\|html" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head; grep -o "g-root[^}]*background[^;]*;" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css | head -5; echo ----; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n "size\|view" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; grep -n "export.*Sun\b\|export.*Moon\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head; echo ----; sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon/types.d.ts; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | grep -n "direction\|gap\|justifyContent\|alignItems\|wrap\|grow" ; sed -n 1,30p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Container/Container.d.ts; grep -n "type ButtonView\|type ButtonSize" -A 3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/*.d.ts | head -12; grep -n "size\|view\|hasClear" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts | head

ls .claude/skills 2>/dev/null; which chromium-cli chromium google-chrome playwright 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,80p /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.318/973e202c13a1bc03bc4f3a45b77e7e40/run/examples/playwright.md

node -e "fetch('http://localhost:5173/').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>console.log(t.slice(0,400)))"; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i -E "play|chrom|puppet"; find / -iname "*chrom*" -maxdepth 4 -type f 2>/dev/null | head; timeout 15 npm view playwright version 2>&1 | tail -2
mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y >/dev/null && timeout 280 npm i playwright@1.64.1 2>&1 | tail -3 && timeout 280 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5
id; sudo -n true 2>&1 | head -1; which apt-get; cat /etc/os-release | head -3
timeout 280 npm i --no-save --no-audit --no-fund jsdom @testing-library/react @testing-library/user-event @testing-library/dom 2>&1 | tail -2; git status --short
npx vitest run --environment jsdom --server.deps.inline "@gravity-ui/uikit" src/smoke.test.tsx 2>&1 | tail -30
cp /tmp/pw/vitest.smoke.config.ts ./vitest.smoke.config.ts && sed -i "s|root: '/home/sandbox/workspace',||" vitest.smoke.config.ts && npx vitest run --config ./vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | tail -40

rm -f src/smoke.test.tsx vitest.smoke.config.ts && rm -rf dist && echo "dist/" >> .gitignore && (lsof -ti:5173 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill; pkill -f "vite --port 5173" 2>/dev/null; true) && npm prune --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -1 && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -4 && rm -rf dist && git status --short && cat .gitignore
